transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy. But I know what's going on. I know they have been watching my moves at work, and they keep changing the pallet counts on my shifts just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Do you ever hear voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes when I'm working in the aisle at the warehouse, or even just at home folding clothes, I hear a man's voice. It's clear as day. He says, "Nicole, check it again." But... there's never anybody near me when it happens.
How long have you been experiencing these thoughts and hearing this voice?
Well, the voice and... you know, the feeling that they're watching me and messing with the counts... it's been going on for about 8 months now.

Aside from the voice you hear, have you noticed any other changes in how you think or behave, such as having trouble organizing your thoughts or feeling like you have lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

I haven't really lost interest in things, but... I guess I have noticed some trouble with my thoughts. Or at least, other people tell me I do. When I try to explain what's going on at the warehouse, it all makes sense in my head. But then my words just kind of run together. I'll be talking about the forklift sheets, and then that reminds me of the signs outside the church, and then I'm talking about the tone my husband uses when he looks at me... and people just get frustrated. They tell me they can't follow what I'm saying or that I'm jumping all over the place. I know what I mean, but it just doesn't come out right, I guess.
Have there been any periods of time during these past eight months where you felt extremely down, hopeless, or unusually energetic and elated?

Well, I haven't really felt hopeless or anything like that. But energetic? Yeah, definitely. There are some days where I just feel so fired up, like I have all this energy and nobody can slow me down. I get so much done. But then... if my husband asks me even one small question, like about the kids or what my schedule is for the day, I just snap at him. It feels like he's interrogating me or trying to control what I'm doing, and it makes me so angry so fast.

During those times when you feel that 'fired up' energy and get so much done, do the voices and the feeling that people are watching you happen at the same time, or do those things continue even when your energy level is normal?

They definitely keep going even when my energy is normal. Like, a little while back, I actually had a few weeks where things were quieter. I was sleeping closer to my regular hours, not rushing around trying to do a million things at once. But... the voice was still there. It was still telling me I needed to double-check everything, and I still knew for a fact that people were messing with the pallet counts to set me up. So yeah, the energy comes and goes, but the voice and the watching... that doesn't stop.

Looking back at the entire eight months, would you say that those 'fired up' periods where you have extra energy happen for a large part of the time you've been dealing with these voices and thoughts, or are they only happening for a relatively small portion of that time?

I'd say it's been going on for a large part of it. If I really look back at the whole eight months... yeah, for more than half of that time, I've had those fired-up periods. It's like, for a lot of this whole stretch, I've been running on barely any sleep, taking on way too much at work and at home, and just getting really irritable if my husband or anyone else tries to slow me down or question me. So, yeah, the extra energy has been there for most of it.
